This is a Next.js 13+ project with TypeScript and TailwindCSS. The project implements a modern chat interface similar to ChatGPT with support for both text and image responses.

Key features to consider when generating code:
1. Use TypeScript for type safety
2. Follow React best practices and hooks
3. Use TailwindCSS for styling
4. Implement responsive design
5. Handle both text and image responses
6. Follow accessibility guidelines
